result.hd95_note: HD95 (the 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance reported in the HD-BET paper) is NOT computed: no implementation exists in HD-BET, nnunetv2 2.8.1 or SimpleITK 2.5.6. The maximum Hausdorff distance reported here is by construction >= HD95 and must not be compared with the paper's HD95 values.
result.hausdorff_note: SimpleITK.HausdorffDistanceImageFilter: maximum symmetric surface distance (hausdorff_max_mm) and average Hausdorff distance (hausdorff_avg_mm) in mm, physical space, computed on the binarised masks.
result.binarisation_note: I/O adaptation: both masks are binarised as uint8(value > threshold) into fresh copies before evaluation, because compute_metrics compares labels by exact equality (== 1) and the Hausdorff filter needs a common integer pixel type; binary {0,1} masks are unchanged by the default threshold 0.5.
